note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. The episode is copied to a neutral folder C:\lab\plNN so no user name shows in paths.

screens.name: sequential
prepare: if (Test-Path C:\lab\pl03\api.pid) { Stop-Process -Id (Get-Content C:\lab\pl03\api.pid) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item C:\lab\pl03\api.pid }

$bin = 'C:\lab\pl03\src\Contoso.Approvals.Api\bin\Debug\net10.0'; $p = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList "$bin\Contoso.Approvals.Api.dll", '--urls', 'http://localhost:5080' -WorkingDirectory $bin -RedirectStandardOutput C:\lab\pl03\api.log -RedirectStandardError C:\lab\pl03\api.err -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru; $p.Id | Set-Content C:\lab\pl03\api.pid; Start-Sleep -Seconds 4
screens.note: The Finance API runs as a hidden background process of the laptop (not the left pane of the split terminal); its real log is shown with Get-Content api.log. For the split-pane look, record in Windows Terminal with the API in the left pane instead.

screens.name: cancel
steps: Left pane: cd C:\lab\pl03; Clear-Host; dotnet run --project src\Contoso.Approvals.Api (or the built dll with --urls http://localhost:5080) and wait for 'Now listening on: http://localhost:5080'
Right pane: cd C:\lab\pl03; dotnet run --no-build --project src\Contoso.Approvals.Cli -- timeout --timeout-ms 150  (expect TimeoutException after ~158 ms, Aborted = 1)
Right pane: dotnet run --no-build --project src\Contoso.Approvals.Cli -- waitasync --timeout-ms 150  (TimeoutException, Aborted = 0; left pane shows start + done 300 ms)

Right pane: dotnet run --no-build --project src\Contoso.Approvals.Cli -- sequential and press Ctrl+C after about 1.5 s (expect 'Ctrl+C: cancelling...' and 'Cancelled after ...'; left pane shows two 'ABORTED by the client' lines)
Frame both panes; stop the API with Ctrl+C in the left pane afterwards
mask: window and tab titles: set $Host.UI.RawUI.WindowTitle to 'api' and 'client'; short prompt function prompt { '> ' } in both panes
